name: Emergency Fund Planner
description: Calculates the target emergency fund size based on the user's monthly essential expenses, builds a savings timeline, and determines the monthly contribution needed to reach the target. Produces a funded emergency fund plan with milestones and a contribution schedule. Use when the user asks about emergency funds, emergency savings, building a financial safety net, or how much to save for emergencies. Do NOT use for general savings goals (use savings-goals-tracker), investment planning, or business cash reserves.
